blocks.text: COTABATO CITY- Two Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) personnel were shot dead by two unidentified gunmen along Roman Vilo Street in Poblacion 6 here at noon on Thursday. Capt. Steffi Salanguit, spokesperson for the Police Regional Office Bangsamoro Autonomous Region (PROBAR), identified the fatalities as Seaman Second Class Reniel Agpalo, a resident of Nueva Ecija, and Apprentice Seaman Louther John Vitor, a resident of Butuan City. Both were assigned to the PCG Cotabato City Station. READ: Cotabato village councilman, brother killed in gun attack The two victims sustained gunshot wounds to the head. Lt.
